storeListing.shortDescription: Schema-driven document filing and workflow automation for Google Drive and Gmail across project and proposal spaces.
storeListing.detailedDescription:
INC-IO Docs is a Google Workspace Add-on providing schema-driven document filing and workflow automation directly within Google Drive and Gmail.

Seamless Document Filing:
Organize incoming files and correspondence into structured DocumentSpaces (such as Projects and Proposals) without leaving your workspace. When triggered from Google Drive or Gmail, INC-IO Docs dynamically evaluates document context and presents contextual forms tailored to your organization's schema.

Schema-Driven Workflow:
Select from defined DocumentTypes like Communication Projects, Proposals, and Transmittals. Dynamic DocumentField inputs guide users to capture essential metadata, target contacts, project numbers, and dates while enforcing validation rules and standardized naming conventions.

Drive and Gmail Integration:
Whether filing an active email thread and converting messages to PDF in Gmail or selecting assets in Google Drive, INC-IO Docs orchestrates folder resolution, sanitized subfolder creation, and automated file movement into your destination Shared Drive spaces.
